subtitle: Out Manila · Philippine Airlines
overview: This 6-day tour flies Philippine Airlines from Manila to Shanghai on a late-night flight. You visit Suzhou’s Jinji Lake and Pingjiang Road, Nianhua Bay in Wuxi, and Shanghai’s Nanjing Road, the Bund and Oriental Pearl Tower. Day 4 is free, with optional Shanghai Disneyland or a city tour. Hotels are 4-star, and the programme includes several shop stops.
travelDatesNote: Departures from Manila, Dec 15–20 2026 to Dec 15–20 2026. The rate changes by date: an amount on a date is added to the base rate per pax. Seats are limited and confirmed at booking.

placeDesc.Jinji Lake: A large lake in Suzhou's modern district, with waterfront parks and skyline views.
placeDesc.The Gate of the Orient: A tall curved landmark building in Suzhou by Jinji Lake, viewed from outside.
placeDesc.Pingjiang Road: A historic canal-side street in Suzhou's old town lined with traditional shops and teahouses.
placeDesc.Nianhua Bay (Mini Kyoto): A Wuxi tourist town on Taihu Lake with Japanese-inspired architecture, nicknamed Mini Kyoto.
placeDesc.The Bund: Shanghai's riverside promenade lined with historic buildings, with views across the Huangpu River.
placeDesc.Oriental Pearl Tower: A landmark TV tower in Pudong with spheres on its frame; viewed from outside.
placeDesc.Chenghuang Temple Market: A traditional-style market area in Shanghai's old city with shops and snack stalls.
placeDesc.Shanghai Disneyland (optional): Optional free-day tour: the Disney theme park in Pudong, with a day pass and hotel transfers.
placeDesc.Xintiandi (optional): A Shanghai dining and shopping district of restored stone-gate houses, part of the optional city tour.
placeDesc.Jinmao Tower (optional): A landmark skyscraper in Pudong, part of the optional city tour.
